vulnerabilities.description: Unsafe strcpy() call without bounds validation
vulnerabilities.rootCause: Unbounded strcpy into 'device_name' from 'input' without length validation
vulnerabilities.fixAdvice: Replace with strncpy(dst, src, sizeof(dst) - 1) and ensure explicit null termination.
vulnerabilities.impactAnalysis: Remote code execution or control-flow hijacking via buffer corruption

vulnerabilities.rootCause: Pointer 'record' is freed without immediately being assigned to NULL
vulnerabilities.fixAdvice: Nullify pointer immediately after free (ptr = NULL) or pass as double pointer.
vulnerabilities.impactAnalysis: Remote code execution or control-flow hijacking via buffer corruption

vulnerabilities.rootCause: Dynamic allocation for 'reading' is dereferenced without verifying ptr != NULL
vulnerabilities.fixAdvice: Add if (ptr == NULL) { return NULL/error; } immediately after allocation.
vulnerabilities.impactAnalysis: Denial of service or memory disclosure on target microcontroller

vulnerabilities.rootCause: User-controlled variable 'event_message' passed directly as format specifier to printf()
vulnerabilities.fixAdvice: Provide explicit format string: printf("%s", variable).

userReviews.title: Exceptional AST Verification Pipeline
userReviews.feedback: Tested the stack overflow and integer multiplication overflow patches on ARM Cortex-M4. The verification checks detected zero memory leaks and prevented premature return bypasses.

userReviews.title: Outstanding memory-safety verification for Cortex-M
userReviews.feedback: The anti-cheating gate and AddressSanitizer simulation are incredible. It caught two subtle buffer truncations that other static linters completely missed.

userReviews.title: AI Security Assistant understands true embedded constraints
userReviews.feedback: Having the Gemini assistant explain compiler flags and ROM/RAM overhead in context makes reviewing C patches 10x faster.
